                    (dist[depot][a1] + dist[depot][b2] - dist[a1][b2], rev(ri) + rev(rj)),
                ]
                for gain, merged in cand:
                    key = (gain, len(merged), i, j, merged)
                    if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best_move is not None and key < best_move[0]):
                        best_gain = gain
                        best_move = (key, i, j, merged)
        if best_move is not None and best_gain > 0:
            _, i, j, merged = best_move
            routes[i] = merged
            loads[i] = rload(merged)
            routes.pop(j)
            loads.pop(j)
            changed = True

    def two_opt_best(r):
        n = len(r)
        if n < 4:
            return r, False
        best_r = r
        best_c = rcost(r)
        improved = False
        for i in range(n - 2):
            for k in range(i + 2, n):
                if i == 0 and k == n - 1:
                    continue
                cand = r[:i + 1] + rev(r[i + 1:k + 1]) + r[k + 1:]
                c = rcost(cand)
                if c < best_c or (c == best_c and cand < best_r):
                    best_c = c
                    best_r = cand
                    improved = True
        return best_r, improved

    def route_delta_insert(r, pos, node):
        left = depot if pos == 0 else r[pos - 1]
        right = depot if pos == len(r) else r[pos]
        return dist[left][node] + dist[node][right] - dist[left][right]

    def route_delta_remove(r, pos):
        node = r[pos]
        left = depot if pos == 0 else r[pos - 1]
        right = depot if pos + 1 == len(r) else r[pos + 1]
        return dist[left][right] - dist[left][node] - dist[node][right]

    # Local search: intra-route 2-opt, relocate, swap
    outer = 0
    improved = True
    while improved and outer < 60:
        improved = False
        outer += 1

        # Intra-route 2-opt
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            nr, imp = two_opt_best(routes[i])
            if imp:
                routes[i] = nr
                improved = True

        # Inter-route relocate
        best_move = None
        best_gain = 0
        base_total = total_cost(routes)
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            ri = routes[i]
            for pos in range(len(ri)):
                node = ri[pos]
                dnode = demands[node]
                for j in range(len(routes)):
                    if i == j or loads[j] + dnode > capacity:
                        continue
                    rj = routes[j]
                    rem_delta = route_delta_remove(ri, pos)
                    tmp_ri = ri[:pos] + ri[pos + 1:]
                    if not tmp_ri:
                        continue
                    for ins in range(len(rj) + 1):
                        ins_delta = route_delta_insert(rj, ins, node)
                        new_ri_cost = rcost(tmp_ri)
                        new_rj = rj[:ins] + [node] + rj[ins:]
                        new_cost = base_total - rcost(ri) - rcost(rj) + new_ri_cost + rcost(new_rj)
                        gain = base_total - new_cost
                        key = (gain, i, j, pos, ins, node)
                        if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best_move is not None and key < best_move[0]):
                            best_gain = gain
                            best_move = (key, i, j, pos, ins)
        if best_move is not None and best_gain > 0:
            _, i, j, pos, ins = best_move
            node = routes[i][pos]
            routes[i] = routes[i][:pos] + routes[i][pos + 1:]
            loads[i] -= demands[node]
            routes[j] = routes[j][:ins] + [node] + routes[j][ins:]
            loads[j] += demands[node]
            if not routes[i]:
                routes.pop(i)
                loads.pop(i)
            improved = True
            continue

        # Inter-route swap
        best_move = None
        best_gain = 0
        base_total = total_cost(routes)
        m = len(routes)
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(i + 1, m):
                ri = routes[i]
                rj = routes[j]
                for pi in range(len(ri)):
                    a = ri[pi]
                    da = demands[a]
                    for pj in range(len(rj)):
                        b = rj[pj]
                        db = demands[b]
                        ni = loads[i] - da + db
                        nj = loads[j] - db + da
                        if ni > capacity or nj > capacity:
                            continue
                        nri = ri[:pi] + [b] + ri[pi + 1:]
                        nrj = rj[:pj] + [a] + rj[pj + 1:]
                        new_cost = base_total - rcost(ri) - rcost(rj) + rcost(nri) + rcost(nrj)
                        gain = base_total - new_cost
                        key = (gain, i, j, pi, pj, a, b)
                        if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and best_move is not None and key < best_move[0]):
                            best_gain = gain
                            best_move = (key, i, j, pi, pj)
        if best_move is not None and best_gain > 0:
            _, i, j, pi, pj = best_move
            a = routes[i][pi]
            b = routes[j][pj]
            routes[i][pi] = b
            routes[j][pj] = a
            loads[i] = loads[i] - demands[a] + demands[b]
            loads[j] = loads[j] - demands[b] + demands[a]
            improved = True

    # Final cleanup: remove empties if any and ensure deterministic order.
    final_routes = []
    for r in routes:
        if r:
            final_routes.append(r)

    return final_routes
